template.name: Landledger: ask the approver in Slack
template.description: When a Landledger request waits on its approvers, each gets a Slack card with the request, the month’s numbers and Approve / Reject buttons. A press is relayed to Landledger as that person’s decision (their Slack email is their Landbright identity), with the hash of what the card showed; the card then says what happened.

credentials.name: Landledger
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with read and decisions:relay. Managing the webhook needs an admin key, or put the whsec_ secret of a webhook an admin made in Webhook Signing Secret.

credentials.name: Slack bot
credentials.description: A bot token (xoxb-…) with chat:write, users:read and users:read.email, and the app’s signing secret (for the button presses).

setup: Pick or add the **Landledger** credential: an `ll_` key with `read` and `decisions:relay` (and `admin`, or the `whsec_` secret of a webhook an admin made, for **Step waits on approvers**).
Pick the **Slack bot**: a bot token with `chat:write`, `users:read` and `users:read.email`, and the signing secret.
Publish, then set **Button pressed**’s URL as the Slack app’s **Interactivity Request URL**.
An approver is found in Slack by their Landbright email; a press is relayed with the presser’s Slack email. Landledger decides whether that person may decide: never the requester or the sponsor.
A card shows what Landledger showed at that moment; if the request changed since, Landledger refuses the relayed decision and the card says so.

workflow.name: Landledger: ask the approver in Slack
workflow.description: Slack cards with Approve / Reject for a Landledger step; a press is relayed as the presser’s decision.

nodes.name: Get the request
nodes.notes: The request and the evidence Landledger shows, with the hash of exactly that: the card shows it and the decision names it.

nodes.name: Send the card
nodes.notes: A direct message to the approver (a member ID as the channel opens their DM).

nodes.name: Button pressed
nodes.notes: Set this node's URL as the Slack app's Interactivity Request URL. Slack signs every press; the signing secret is in the credential.

nodes.name: Who pressed
nodes.notes: The presser's Slack profile: their email is their Landbright identity (needs users:read.email).

nodes.name: Relay the decision
nodes.notes: Landledger records the decision as this person's, relayed by the key; it refuses anyone who is not an approver of the step, the requester or sponsor, and a step that moved on.

nodes.name: Update the card
nodes.notes: The buttons give way to what happened, so nobody presses twice.
